vulnerability.name: GO-2026-6094
vulnerability.description: github.com/google/cel-go: JSON private fields exposed via NativeTypes and ParseStructTag

statements.impact_statement: Caddy compiles github.com/google/cel-go/ext into polaris-caddy, but neither function the advisory names, ext.NativeTypes or ext.ParseStructTag, is in the binary: its function names, read from the symbol table the build keeps, include other cel-go/ext functions and neither of these.

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unmaintained and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: No golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is in the polaris-caddy build: go mod why reports that the main module does not need any openpgp package, and the binary's function names, read from the symbol table the build keeps, include none from openpgp.
